statement: In the Calegari S5 family, let B be the single quadratic Hecke factor over the degree-six F20 field, C the rational quadratic factor, and A the specified cuspidal GL5 comparison. Assuming only B has no off-centre real zeros in(0,1), their central orders satisfy beta>=b+n. Equality, equivalently beta<=b+n, is equivalent to a finite exceptional set and exact all-place transfer of both rank-five factors. Thus the remaining comparison gate is the positive central excess beta-b-n. The same real-zero input forces the positive exceptional Euler quotient to be zero-free on Re(s)>1/2 and excludes every real Artin pole. Full GRH for B transfers to the known GL5 numerator and C even before exact transfer. The remaining central excess equals n_eta-ord(zeta_F); if positive, the exceptional-prime harmonic sum has exact singularity(k/4)log(1/epsilon)+O(1).
input: One additional conditional real-zero assertion R_B for a single quadratic Hecke function suffices for the central comparison, exceptional-prime summability and real-axis Artin holomorphy; universal Masullo M_H is sufficient but stronger. Full GRH for B is additionally used for GRH of the specified GL5 numerator and C. No Alpoge input is needed for these deductions. Classical Calegari local hypotheses and comparison construction remain.
